response: An "approved label" means a label that has been approved under Part 2 of either the Agvet Code of a State or the Northern Territory, or Part 2 of the Agvet Code of the participating Territories within the meaning of the Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals Act 1994. This definition is found in section 112B of the Copyright Act 1998 (as consolidated 2002), which deals with the reproduction of writing on labels for containers for chemical products, stating that such reproduction is not an infringement of copyright under section 92.
